items.heading: Writing Skills Mean the Ability
items.text: Writing skills mean the ability to express ideas clearly for a specific reader. They include structure, word choice, editing and tone, and they matter in almost every job.

items.heading: Collect Ten Notices That Name
items.text: Collect ten notices that name writing and sort them by type. Write two samples of the most common type and ask a reader for marks.
